pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregular dark-tan regions exhibiting sharp pixel-level gradients at the margins. Spatial area of patches decreases in size from the mid-flank toward the lower hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways separating patches. Thickness is variable, narrowing at junction nodes which primarily consist of tri-directional intersections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized cluster of small, dark, punctate marks on the lower left hindquarter region, indicating possible superficial textural disruption.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent tail structure curled upward across the posterior, featuring a dense terminal tuft of elongated black filiform structures.
